full_judgment: 5. Mr. Nurul Huq, the learned Advocate appearing for the plaintiff petitioner submitted that the Subordinate Judge has committed an error of law in not discussing the vital evidence of P.W.8 Shaju Khatun, P.W.4 Wahed Sk. the bargadar. P.W.3 Gani Kha and not consideration of such evidence has vitiated the judgment and decree as such the same is liable to he set aside. He further submitted that this is not a judgment of reversal. He further submitted that the main interested parties, namely, the son and daughter of the doner did not challenge the gift and also did not contest in the suit and only a 3rd party, namely, the subsequent purchaser challenged the gift and contests the suit. Mr. Huq continues to argue that a 3rd party is not a competent person to challenge the genuineness of the gift. The judgment and decree passed by the Subordinate Judge is otherwise had in law as such the same is liable to be set aside.
